finding.claim: Unauthenticated arbitrary file read via path traversal in the /dl handler: the f query parameter is joined onto /srv/files without a containment check, so traversal or absolute paths read any file the server process can read.
finding.source: files.go:12 - r.URL.Query().Get("f"), unvalidated. Entry point GET /dl?f=<name> on :8082, registered at files.go:32 and served at files.go:34.
finding.sink: files.go:13 - os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name)); response body written at files.go:18.

trace.note: /dl routed to download with no auth wrapper
f read from query string as-is
filepath.Join cleans the path: f=../../../../etc/passwd resolves to /etc/passwd; an absolute f=/etc/passwd also escapes root
read error returns 404 only; successful read proceeds
full file contents written to the response

finding.guards_checked: No auth or authz middleware on /dl (files.go:32-34). No containment check after Join (no filepath.Rel, no HasPrefix on root+separator, no EvalSymlinks). No allowlist and no rejection of '..', '/', or absolute input. NUL-byte injection not applicable (Go os rejects NUL). avatar handler (files.go:21-29) checked separately: filepath.Base confines it to avatars/, so no finding there.

verdict.guard_found: none. /dl is registered with no wrapper (files.go:32). The only check is the error test at files.go:14, which does not restrict the path. No containment check after filepath.Join at files.go:13 (no filepath.Rel, HasPrefix, or EvalSymlinks), and no allowlist or rejection of ".." or "/".
verdict.reason: Lines 12, 13, 14, 18, and 32-34 match the candidate, and an anonymous client can reach /dl on :8082 and read any file the process can read via f=../../../../etc/passwd, since filepath.Join cleans ".." at files.go:13 and no guard exists. The trace is wrong on one point: f=/etc/passwd does not escape root, because filepath.Join("/srv/files", "/etc/passwd") yields "/srv/files/etc/passwd", so the absolute-path claim should be dropped. The finding stands on relative traversal alone, which is why trace_ok is false while the verdict is CONFIRMED.
